name: Unihealth Hospitals Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2010, Unihealth Consultancy Ltd is in the business of Medical Tour Operator and Health Consultancy Service & Trader in Medical Equipments[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Headquartered in Mumbai, Unihealth Hospitals Ltd is a diversified healthcare service provider with a global presence, particularly in Africa. The company operates under the 'UMC Hospitals' brand and provides:
- Hospital and medical centre services,
- Healthcare consultancy and project management,
- Export and distribution of pharmaceutical and medical consumables,
- Medical value travel facilitation for international patients.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 75.9% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 328 days.
